name: Divide Depot, Colorado Midland Railroad: 'All change for Cripple Creek'
basis: Catalogue record of the holding library, read on 2026-11-24.
notes: Men in winter clothes in front of the depot; a Colorado Midland train on the track in front of it; snow patches. Copied from 'Cripple Creek and Colorado Springs Illustrated' (1896), p. 101, and the copy negative carries other printed text from that book: crop to the photograph before showing. This is the depot before the 1903 rebuild that secondary sources report, so it is not the standing building.
